Frontend Developer — Craftline Studio (Remote)

Craftline is a boutique product studio building marketing sites and design systems for funded startups. You will own responsive builds on the Tailwind CSS framework, set up Git/GitHub CI/CD for our component library, and ship production React pages from Figma comps.

We prize engineers who have BUILT design systems and open-source tools — shipped something real that others use, maintained a public repo, written about what you built. If you are the sort of engineer who contributes back to the ecosystem you rely on, you will fit right in.

Requirements: 3+ years front-end, production experience with Tailwind CSS, Git/GitHub workflow, and a portfolio we can look at.
